thesis: The page is a botanical garden index: every section is an embossed plant marker naming what thrives in Savannah, where it lives, and what light and season it needs, so homeowners trust the plants chosen will survive their specific yard.

signature.name: Botanical Plant Marker
signature.summary: An embossed tag primitive with common name, Latin italic, and location/light line; appears as hero label, service cards, review tags, and footer area pills.

motion.intro: Arch mask opens from vertical slit to full arch (clip-path 900ms ease-out); headline letters fade in with 70ms stagger.
stories: Dappled-light CSS gradient drifts across dark sections (8s cycle, paused reduced-motion)
Plant markers press in on scroll entry (scale .96→1 + emboss shadow 500ms)
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX(0→1) 200ms accent color on links and buttons.
